subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the reference for the protagonist: a young woman with long, slightly wavy dark hair, glittering eye makeup, glossy lips, and long, sparkly manicured nails. She wears a dusty pink off-the-shoulder knit top with a cutout detail, and dangling earrings. <Picture 1> shows her in a cozy, warmly lit living room, holding her hand up near her face to show off her nails.
(CRITICAL NOTE: Absolute visual consistency. The woman's face, wavy dark hair, dusty pink top, sparkly nails, and the warm, vintage CCD camera aesthetic MUST remain identical in every frame. No morphological drift. Keep the raw, slightly grainy film texture.)

summary:
[reference generation] A 10-second continuous, playful vlog-style sequence: the girl from <Picture 1> playfully shows off her new sparkly nails to the camera, leans in close to blow a kiss, and playfully pushes the camera away with a sweet laugh.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> (appears throughout the sequence): fully_preserved - long wavy hair, glittering makeup, dusty pink off-shoulder top, sparkly nails, and the warm cozy room are strictly retained without any morphological drift. The camera maintains a continuous, fluid, handheld tracking motion without hard cuts or slow motion.

detailed_description:
The target video is a top-tier cinematic Y2K vlog style with strict character consistency. Visual quality: Warm indoor lighting, direct flash CCD camera texture, slight motion blur, heavy organic grain, and a highly realistic, intimate atmosphere.
Stage: a cozy living room. The camera moves with a fluid, handheld, continuous drift, capturing her playful energy.

The sequence starts with a close-up, matching <Picture 1> exactly. The direct flash hits S1's face, highlighting the glitter around her eyes and her glossy lips. She holds her right hand up, wiggling her long, sparkly nails right in front of the lens. The camera pushes in slightly. She smiles brightly, her eyes curving, and speaks in a sweet, playful voice in Chinese: “看！新做的指甲，闪不闪？” (Look! New nails, are they sparkly?).
At 00:02.500, flowing seamlessly without cuts, S1 lowers her hand and leans in very close to the camera lens. Her long wavy hair falls over her shoulders, brushing against the dusty pink knit top. The camera shakes slightly with her movement. She blows a playful kiss toward the lens and says with a cheeky grin in Chinese: “今天心情好，给你个福利。” (I'm in a good mood today, giving you a little treat.).
At 00:05.500, continuing the motion, she suddenly reaches out with both hands, her sparkly nails grabbing the edges of the camera frame. She pushes the camera back playfully, laughing out loud. The camera wobbles, catching the cozy background of the sofa and the lamp. She says with a mischievous tone in Chinese: “好了好了，看够了没？不许再盯着看啦！” (Okay, okay, have you seen enough? No more staring!).
At 00:07.500, flowing into the finale, S1 lets go of the camera and steps back, crossing her arms loosely over her chest. She tilts her head, giving a final, sassy wink to the lens. The warm light catches her dangling earrings. She says with a sweet, dismissive smile in Chinese: “我该去忙啦，下次见。” (I should go get busy, see you next time.). The camera holds as she turns away, her long hair swaying, and the scene slowly fades into the warm, grainy light of the room.

overall_soundscape: The sharp, direct flash of a camera, the rustle of knit fabric, the soft clinking of her dangling earrings, her bright and clear laughter, and her playful voice.

non_diegetic_music: A light, upbeat, vintage pop track with a catchy bassline and subtle vinyl crackle. The music is fun and flirty, perfectly matching her vlog-style energy, fading out with a soft, lingering synth note as she turns away.
